map.1: [Thok]	A performance to sing tales of! It tough for anyone to top that.
map.2: [Mr Mordaut]	A marvellous display. I've not seen such skill for at least two centuries.
map.13: [Raptor]	Don't try to escape me fish. I'll be coming after you.
map.22: [Mr Mordaut]	Indeed. A great performance from our athlete.
map.23: [Raptor]	Now, dragon, time to meet my flail!
map.24: [Mr Mordaut]	*Sigh* Oh, do go away, Raptor.
map.31: [Mr Mordaut]	Wonderful! A fantastic show. Bravo athlete, bravo!
map.41: [Thok]	Haha! A good round! Well done, squishy person!
map.44: [Tentacle]	Why are there two of you?
map.51: [Thok]	Keep it up, squishy athlete, and you'll be almost as good as Thok.
map.61: [Thok]	A good game, you make Thok proud.
map.65: [Thok]	Sorry, Thok thought you were about to make rude comment.
